scope: Author-reported GDEA price snapshot; sequential historical prediction, not vintage real-time certification
target: Unmodified original price at 1,5,20 future OBSERVATION steps; no future calendar gaps as inputs
reserved: 2023 excluded from model and metric functions; old EU holdout remains closed
primary_metric: Mean across years and horizons of model MSE / RW MSE; each year,horizon equal weight; neural seeds averaged in loss, not prediction
scoring: Origin and all three targets must fall within SAME scoring year; common origins shared by all models
features: 60 past prices relative to current price, divided by strictly causal 60-difference RMS with floor 0.05 training one-step RMS; one past log calendar-gap feature
candidate: delta_hat_h = q_t * ((h/20)*u_theta(x) + (1-exp(-h/tau_theta(x)))*v_theta(x)), tau in [0.5,40]. h=0 yields delta=0. NOT a proven new algorithm.
neural_controls: free three-output MLP with identical trunk and parameter count
same response head with one learned GLOBAL tau rather than conditional tau
loss: Original delta squared error divided by FIXED training-only horizon squared scale; no smoothing or substitution of target
maturity: All methods train on origin i only if i+20 <= refit origin; identical complete-label support for causal mechanism comparison
hyperparameter_selection: Family-wise tuning 2019/2020 only; candidate picked within its own family; control families selected separately; also report candidate-matched neural control settings. No reselection after historical check.
bootstrap: 2000 paired moving-block draws within each check year; length40 primary,20 and60 sensitivities; all horizons/methods jointly; model-selection uncertainty not resolved by bootstrap
synthetic: Independent RW, integrated drift+transient AR, and state-varying transient persistence controls; five fixed path seeds; neural training seed11 and hyperparameters lr.001,wd.01 fixed irrespective market scores; report oracle; diagnosis only
decision: Advance only if candidate beats RW and strongest noncandidate by >=2% primary relative MSE, beats global-tau control by >=1%, no year shows >5% deterioration vs RW; otherwise do not market as established model innovation. Thresholds are project decisions, NOT journal criteria.
historical_check_access: One complete run of all preselected families after code tests; do not modify model or tuning grid based on check scores
